title: Cross-hardware Pi0.5 / ImageWAM benchmark result
description: One JSON file per (model, implementation, hardware, precision) run. Every field is required unless marked nullable; a value that cannot be produced is recorded explicitly (null, or status != "ok"), never omitted.

precision.description: e.g. bf16, fp16, fp8, fp8_static, fp8_static_cutlass, nvfp4, int8. Whatever this run actually used -- do not normalize away real precision names.

status.description: "ok": timing/correctness fields are real measurements. "blocked": construction or the run could not be attempted at all (record why in notes; every timing/correctness field is null). "error": attempted and failed (record the failure in notes; timing/correctness fields are null unless partially measured before the failure, which must then be explained in notes).

text_tokens.description: null if not applicable to this model

checkpoint.description: checkpoint name/path if random_weights is false, else null

matches_target.description: true only if num_views/num_flow_steps/action_dim/action_horizon exactly equal the frozen target config (3, 10, 32, 30) at 224x224. false is expected and fine for interim real-checkpoint runs -- record the real shape used, do not force it.

commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD of the FlashRT checkout this run used; "n/a" for a torch_official run with no FlashRT checkout

clock_locked.description: null if unknown/not checked on this device

notes.description: Free text. Mandatory content when status != "ok" (why), when config.matches_target is false (what differs and why), or when anything about this run deviates from the protocol doc. Empty string only when status is "ok", config.matches_target is true, and nothing else needs saying.
